title: Synthetic near-miss report 02
text: Forklift reversing alarm found inoperative in the laydown yard; unit tagged out and repaired. No contact with people or equipment.

title: Synthetic incident report 05
text: Eyewash station flow test at Unit 3 was below the required rate; maintenance ticket raised and station signed out of service.

title: Synthetic good catch report 06
text: Good catch report: crew on Line A waited 90 minutes for zero-energy verification and did not begin work until sign-off was complete.

title: Synthetic near-miss report 04
text: Crew started valve work on Line C before zero-energy sign-off while waiting for an available inspector.

title: Synthetic near-miss report 07
text: Work began on a transfer pump before zero-energy verification was signed off.
